boundary: Manual finalization review records for specific Nano Hunter image_gen outputs. Approval is asset-scoped and does not approve unrelated candidates, external tools, future commercial storefront material, or the full asset package.

terms_review.review_summary: OpenAI Terms of Use assign OpenAI's rights in Output to the user to the extent permitted by law, while requiring compliance with laws, rights, policies, and human review for appropriate use. Similar outputs and third-party output are not covered by this approval.
caveats: Does not cover non-OpenAI tools or purchased / third-party assets.
Does not remove the need for human review before public marketing or storefront release.
Does not assert uniqueness of generated output.
Does not cover future edited assets unless they keep this provenance chain.

Stage16 DemoShell menu icon sheet is approved only for the current Alpha Demo menu icon strip. Candidate 04 was generated with built-in image_gen as an exact 2x3 sheet for pause, continue/play, restart, completion seal, back, and locked/disabled icons, then copied into the project and converted from a flat magenta chroma key to RGBA alpha. Pixel validation showed transparent corners, no opaque magenta residue and no opaque green residue; 48px preview remains readable, and semantics / regions now match the six grid cells. This approval does not cover a full final icon design system, future button-state redesign, unrelated HUD atlas regions, storefront UI, or public marketing material.

Core icon sheet is approved only as the current Alpha Demo internal source atlas for icon-region browsing and editor AtlasTexture preview. This approval does not cover direct gameplay HUD/menu binding by the older semantic names, a final icon design system, storefront UI, marketing material, or replacement of the dedicated Air Dash, Recovery Charge, or Stage16 menu icon assets.

HUD core UI atlas is approved only as the current Alpha Demo TutorialHUD source atlas preview and editor AtlasTexture resource set. This approval does not cover replacing actual gameplay health, boss health, recovery charge, Air Dash state, final Theme mappings, complete HUD design system, storefront UI, or public marketing material.
